subject: 29-year-old woman with open-orbit collar
art_direction: 29岁女性戴巨大不闭合圆领，珊瑚红短发像切纸，青蓝外套与奶白空间对照。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Portray an original 29-year-old woman with a blunt coral crop, a broad nose, and an assured small smile. She wears a fully closed teal coat whose oversized cream collar forms an incomplete orbit around the shoulders, leaving the face open. Use gouache planes and cut-paper hair shapes, with minimal facial modeling and no glossy makeup. Turn her shoulders slightly while she looks directly forward. Keep the collar within the frame and use warm ivory negative space. The design should feel like an editorial costume study, not a celebrity portrait. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
